The leg's own denominator moved with it: roles_read 210 -> 256. The SECOND-ORDER tell is sharper than the count: round 3 had to carry `opal-49f-value-parity` in granting_roles_not_in_the_live_graph -- a granting role the repo declares that AWS does not have -- and this run's list is EMPTY, because a live-plane read cannot produce a declared-but-not-live role by construction. The GATE is load-bearing rather than decorative: the census is admitted only after comp-iam reconcile grades it (it graded THIS file 'age 0.0h, TTL 24h [FRESH]'), and rc 3 raises SystemExit instead of degrading to a declared read -- measured against the estate's default census, where the same command returns rc=3 'REFUSED: APPLIED reconcile NOT PERFORMED -- the census carries NO vintage'. comp-iam live runs beside it and prints the cross-check neither read can perform alone: 'population cross-check: graph 248 vs census 256'. The JOIN moved too: a granting role now binds to its graph node by ARN IDENTITY first and by name only as a fallback. ON THE SECOND QUESTION -- ARE THE DROPS EXPLAINED BY THE PLANE OR BY A NARROWER QUESTION: THERE ARE NO DROPS. 19 of 19 node_types held or grew, 381 -> 402 involved, so there is no drop to explain away and no `dropped` list carrying a rationalisation. The leg ADDED: IAM_ROLE 46 -> 56, LAMBDA 67 -> 73, and 50 granting roles. THE NARROWING RISK IS REAL AND IS DISCLOSED RATHER THAN DENIED: the census expands INLINE policy documents and records an attached-managed policy as UNRESOLVED with no Resources text -- 148 of 256 roles carry at least one such statement -- so a grant reachable ONLY through an attached managed policy is not matched by resource text. That is stated in the definition written into coverage.instrument, in the method note, and in the record, with the two things that bound it: the HAS_POLICY sub-leg still reaches such a role when the policy itself carries a token, and the blind spot is asserted by a DRIVEN ARM (e5_legs_control.py, 'BLIND SPOT attached-managed UNRESOLVED statement reaches nobody') so the day the census starts resolving managed policies the arm flips and the sentence is known stale rather than quietly wrong. comp-iam simulate is named as the assigned instrument that would settle one such case and is deliberately NOT used to enumerate a population, because a per-pair oracle asked a population question narrows the question rather than widening the plane -- which is this criterion's own hazard, refused on the record. ON THE HAND SURFACE: GUARDED, not declared, and the guard earns it -- comp-lambdamap check names 3 WRONG_SOURCE_DIR + 9 MISSING_ENTRY, and one of the nine is `opal-49f-value-parity`, a SUBJECT function that is TF-backed and carries no functions{} entry, so the source_text leg is structurally blind to it.
